clusters.pick_reason: #2763's changeset documents a scenario-based test ({ timeout: 1000, maxTotalTimeout: 150 }) verifying the cap is hit and the correct 'Maximum total timeout exceeded' error is raised, and its fix covers both the initial arm (min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout)) and re-arming on progress resets against the remaining budget. #2817 only adds an info.startTime update on reset (plus a one-line test comment tweak) without changing the reset delay itself, so it addresses a symptom of the same bug without enforcing the cap on progress-triggered resets.

members.title: fix(core): enforce maxTotalTimeout without progress notifications
members.author: claxman
members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix incorrect interaction between RequestOptions.maxTotalTimeout and the per-request timeout reset that fires on progress notifications, in Protocol's timeout setup code (packages/core-internal/src/shared/protocol.ts, the _setupTimeout/reset-on-progress block around lines 741-768). #2763 caps the initial timer at min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout) and, per its changeset, re-arms progress resets against the remaining maxTotalTimeout budget, raising 'Maximum total timeout exceeded' when the cap expires. #2817 touches the same progress-reset code path, adding info.startTime = Date.now() on each reset - a narrower fix that only corrects the tracked start time but still resets to the full per-request info.timeout on every progress notification, i.e. it does not itself cap resets against maxTotalTimeout the way #2763's changeset claims to. (2 PRs)
